mechanism.claim: An opposite-direction move in official two-year and ten-year Treasury par yields is a curve twist. A falling front end with a rising long end is easing/growth steepening and maps long BTC; a rising front end with a falling long end is front-end tightening and maps short BTC during elevated BTC variation.
mechanism.side: strict sign(delta10y-delta2y) when the two changes have opposite strict signs
mechanism.why_distinct: TPYSR requires same-sign parallel shocks and never opened economics; HVTCTR uses the disjoint opposite-sign twist state, no TPYSR control, and an extra conservative midday embargo.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed seven-day BTC variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a sparse next-day 12:05 UTC sovereign-curve twist clock is absent from Gross9

features.source: official US Treasury Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates XML snapshot already hash-bound without outcomes
features.transition: consecutive valid Treasury observations one to five calendar days apart
features.twist: delta2 and delta10 strict nonzero with opposite signs
features.availability: source day D plus one calendar day at 12:00 UTC, twelve hours later than the source manifest's conservative floor
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m BTC log returns over seven elapsed days ending at decision)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over all daily 12:00 UTC market states, at most 270 and minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: source-time global half-open nonoverlap; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, twist, side, variation, delay, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
